400.description: Malformed body, an empty required field (buildingId, shiftId, or a line's pathId), no path plan lines supplied (shift-plan-no-path-plans), a line references a path with no installedStations entry (shift-plan-missing-installed-stations), a line's pathId is not declared by the process-path catalogue (unknown-path-id), or the Idempotency-Key header is missing on a deployment with Postgres (idempotency-key-required, ADR-0027).

409.description: Conflict — a line's plannedHeads exceeds installedStations (planned-heads-exceed-installed), a line's plannedHeads exceeds the LIVE installed capacity fulfillment-execution reports for that path's capability, resolved from the process-path catalogue's requiredCapabilities (exceeds-installed-capacity — see ADR-0014; this is a SEPARATE, independent check from installedStations), or plannedHours exceeds what plannedHeads can work within the shift's max hours (planned-hours-exceed-capacity).

This service fails the ENTIRE commit loud in this case rather than falling back to any assumed capacity, since a shift-plan commit mutates real state — see ADR-0014.
